work.description: Motu proprio CCXX raises S. Lorenzo at Urbisaglia (diocese of Macerata) to a collegiate church with a provost, seven canons and two choral benefices, suppressing the parish of S. Giorgio; LF48477 → LF48481 across a row of specks LF48480 (native height 12 px above the right-column baseline); LF48546 → LF48555 across own provenance LF48549 and running title LF48552; page numbers LF48618, LF48684, LF48869 and running titles LF48750, LF48816 excluded; lines LF48429, LF48442, LF48510 and LF48546 carry a literal column-rule mark |; complete 28 May 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF48416–48416; the source closing at LF48885–48887 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum die vigesima octava maii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono.
